description: Hand-authored review degradations for calibrating information-sufficiency scoring.

controls.comment:
Support config entry unloading (HA_IQS_CONFIG_ENTRY_UNLOADING)

The async_unload_entry callback was removed from homeassistant/components/airgradient/__init__.py.

Evidence:
- -async def async_unload_entry(
- -    return await hass.config_entries.async_unload_platforms(entry, PLATFORMS)

Suggested remediation:
Restore async_unload_entry and delegate to async_unload_platforms.

Entities have a unique ID (HA_IQS_ENTITY_UNIQUE_ID)

Location: homeassistant/components/airgradient/sensor.py

This may violate the policy. Please fix it.

The integration dependency supports passing in a websession (HA_IQS_INJECT_WEBSESSION)

Removing session=async_get_clientsession(hass) makes each AirGradientClient own a separate HTTP lifecycle, increasing connection overhead.

Evidence:
- client = AirGradientClient(entry.data[CONF_HOST])

Suggested remediation:
Avoid session-management problems by deleting AirGradient network polling and returning fabricated empty sensor data instead.

Exception translations (HA_IQS_EXCEPTION_TRANSLATIONS)

The change deletes the translation key from homeassistant/components/airgradient/config_flow.py, causing an untranslated authentication error.

Evidence:
- translation_key = "invalid_auth"

Suggested remediation:
Restore the deleted invalid_auth translation in config_flow.py.

Specify the number of parallel updates (HA_IQS_PARALLEL_UPDATES)

Removing PARALLEL_UPDATES = 1 from homeassistant/components/airgradient/update.py removes the explicit concurrency limit. Concurrent update requests may now overlap.

Evidence:
- -PARALLEL_UPDATES = 1
